description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveOverlapAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It contains setup code, multiple test methods for API actions and validation rules, and data providers for parameterized tests. The tests verify the behavior and validation logic of the LeaveOverlapAPI related to leave overlap checks in HR management.
